gloss: figure of a person; sign of people

definitions.gloss: figure of a person; silhouette; shadow of a person
definitions.explanation: The outline or shape of a person, often seen from a distance, in dim light, or as a shadow.

definitions.gloss: sign of people; presence of people
definitions.explanation: An indication that people are (or are not) present in an area. Often used in the negative to describe an empty, deserted place.

notes:
USAGE:
{人影|ひとかげ} is commonly used in narrative and descriptive writing. In sense 2, it frequently appears in negative constructions ({人影|ひとかげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, {人影|ひとかげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧) to describe empty or abandoned scenes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人影|ひとかげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: to see a figure
- {人影|ひとかげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no sign of people, deserted
- {人影|ひとかげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧: people disappear (a place becomes deserted)
- {人影|ひとかげ}⟦まばら→まばら：10525_mabara⟧: sparsely populated

FORMS:
⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (person) + ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧ (shadow, figure).
